Overview

Perugia is a city in Umbria with a population of 163,000. A hilltop Umbrian city famous for its medieval architecture, chocolate festival, and as the gateway to the green heart of Italy. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
